data.name: Switch
data.value: Require a fingerprint, face or screen lock to open the app

data.name: Text.Help
data.value: When enabled, opening the app with a signed-in session asks for your fingerprint, face or screen lock first. It applies to this device only.

data.name: Text.Unavailable
data.value: This device has no fingerprint, face or screen lock set up, so the app lock is not available.

data.name: Prompt.Reason
data.value: Confirm it is you to turn on the app lock

data.name: Snackbar.VerifyFailed
data.value: The identity check did not complete, so the app lock stays off.
